captureMethod: Actual in-app-browser viewport screenshots. Top/end proofs preserve each viewport. Tablet/mobile full-page previews stitch sequential viewport frames at measured scroll positions; repeated fixed bottom navigation is excluded except on the final frame. No full-page desktop stitch because its filter sidebar is sticky.
limitations: All prices, stock and generic technical variations are illustrative fixture data.
Brand identities and stated model facts are verified in catalog-data.md, but generic images are not exact model photography.
Cart, inquiry, account and business requests remain explicit temporary notices.
Favorites remain client session-memory UI state.
No backend, database, product/category details, checkout, authentication or supplier/admin dashboards were added.
